Name: Desert Princess
Author: Hypello10
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#3c78d8][font=Times New Roman]Hooray! Sandy will soon be a Marriage Candidate!![/font][/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[size=3][color=#999999]The Desert Princess is a mysterious flower said to have been beloved by a princess of a once-prosperous desert kingdom.
Its seeds are sold by Sandy. Visit the Calico Desert and purchase them from her.[/color][/size]

[b][u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Main features[/size][/color][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#999999]Sandy now sells Desert Princess seeds.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#999999]Desert Princess produces honey that is more valuable than Fairy Rose honey. [/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#999999]You can trade it with the Desert Trader for several items. [/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#999999][size=3]Several villagers who love flowers will be delighted to receive it. Sandy is one of them, and she has unique dialogue.[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][b][u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Requirements[/size][/color][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#999999]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#999999][size=3]Content Patcher[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][b][u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Installation[/size][/color][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#999999]Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#999999]Download this mod and unzip it into Mods folder.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#999999][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][b][color=#f4f4f4][size=3][u]Notes[/u][/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#999999]I’m new to modding, and this is my first mod. It's a mini mod but I hope you enjoy it![/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#999999]I’m not very good at drawing, so please excuse the low-quality pixel art.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Desert Princess
Manifest.Description: Adds the flower Desert Princess, which can be traded with the Desert Trader.
